newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BETIS LOSE GROUND TO BARCELONA IN SPAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BETIS LOSE GROUND TO BARCELONA IN SPAIN.

text.p: Barcelona's hopes of taking Spain's second European Cup place were boosted on Sunday when rivals Real Betis went down unexpectedly 2-1 at bottom-placed Logrones.
With five games left to play, Betis are six points adrift of Barcelona, who beat Real Madrid 1-0 in a bad-tempered game on Saturday but who are still five points behind the league leaders.
In other games Atletico Madrid's Kiko Narvaez headed the winner as the champions beat Athletic Bilbao 2-1, a result that virtually guarantees Atletico a UEFA Cup place for next season.
Zaragoza pulled out of trouble with a 1-0 win over Espanyol, while Sevilla surprised fellow strugglers Hercules with a crushing 5-0 victory.
